notes: Seven slots mirroring Trinity section 4.1: three closed frontier models plus four open-weight ones, including one open base model in both direct and reasoning mode. Those two slots use the provider's sibling slugs (-instruct-2507 / -thinking-2507), not one hybrid slug, because a request-level reasoning toggle is advisory and would silently collapse them into the same agent. Slugs are filled by scripts/preflight_agents.py after scripts/select_pool.py runs the Appendix A.6 selection over a screening matrix.

agents.description: Strong anchor, slot 1 of 3. Large open MoE reasoner; stands in for the paper's GPT-5 role on a budget pool.
Strong anchor, slot 2 of 3. A different vendor and architecture from slot 0 so failure profiles differ.
Strong anchor, slot 3 of 3. Balanced rather than peaked; often the best fixed agent, which is what makes S* honest.
